dedup.scope: MCMT 21.16 (900009002) gives countable-chain marginal total-variation convergence via product coupling. MCMT 21.19 (900009003) concerns null recurrence and one-time transition probabilities. Public 173812 gives pointwise averages along a selected return-time sequence for rapidly mixing systems. C.1 gives all-time sample-path averages for finite irreducible chains, including periodic chains.

source_caveats: The proof uses finite state space and bounded f, as printed, and invokes the strong law with a citation to A.8. A.8 is printed with a linear variance bound. Lemma 1.13 proves geometric block-tail domination for these finite chains. The interpolation exercise and selected solution use shifted summation endpoints. Preserve the source convention at each location. The exercise and selected solution support this single item.
